name: BMG LABTECH PHERAstar FSX
status_line: Not in PyLabRobot. Upstream drives 2 other BMG readers; this one's commands are unknown.
reaches: Unknown. Upstream's 2 BMG readers share 1 framing module: the CLARIOstar speaks FTDI frames (STX, size, header, payload, 24-bit sum, CR) or USB packets, the VANTAstar USB only. The host asks, then polls status.
decoded_from: Nothing decoded. The example runs the method on a synthetic reader whose payloads are the text TODO_1..TODO_4. Upstream has no PHERAstar code; its registry lists only CLARIOstar and VANTAstar for BMG (docs/_static/devices.json:253-287).
steps: Check how it enumerates on USB (FTDI bridge or native USB, VID and PID) against the 2 BMG readers upstream drives (pylabrobot/bmg_labtech/clariostar/driver/framing.py:6 and pylabrobot/bmg_labtech/vantastar/driver/framing.py:4).
Capture the vendor software doing 1 action at a time (tray out, tray in, 1 read), marking each action, with plr-re capture and marks.
Test the sibling framing on the capture: does every frame fit the FTDI frame or the USB packet layout (pylabrobot/bmg_labtech/protocol/framing.py:3-17)?
Map status and error replies before any motion: which bits mean busy, tray out, refused, error, and which codes come back.
Write the 1-class driver and replay the captured transcripts as tests through a fake transport, per the device-driver guide section 5.
First live command read-only (status), then the tray, then a read of an empty plate, with a person at the reader.
scenario: A stand-in for the vendor software moves the tray out and in and reads a 384-well plate on a synthetic reader; the frames are captured, decoded, replayed behind guards, then read by a draft class.
real: Upstream BMG framing functions build and check every frame
plr_re Marks, load_serial_log, diff_frames, scan_modbus_stream, ProtocolMap, GuardedReplayer
simulated: The reader, its tray, plate and 384 made-up values
Every command payload: ASCII TODO_1..TODO_4, not PHERAstar bytes
The vendor software session that was captured
not_checked: Any PHERAstar byte, port, header, status bit or error code
Whether the PHERAstar shares the CLARIOstar and VANTAstar framing
The draft class on any hardware
limits: BMG's page says its readers can be controlled through ActiveX, DDE and SiLA interfaces, documented in its software manuals. That route may need no wire decoding.

Same maker as 2 decoded readers is a hypothesis to test first, not a result. Upstream lists CLARIOstar firmware 1.35 only as checked on hardware (pylabrobot/bmg_labtech/clariostar/driver/confirmed_firmware_versions.py:5).

plr_re replays a stored frame and reads once (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/replay.py:99-102), 512 bytes by default (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/transports.py:24). The example reads the rest of the 780-byte reply itself.

plr_re splits only Modbus RTU streams (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/decode.py:132) and drops timestamps on load (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/decode.py:160-170). The example splits and groups by marks itself.
